description: Step 2 after create_media_upload_url and the PUT: checks the file arrived, is within the declared size and really is a supported video/image (by its bytes), stores it in the user's account and returns its mediaId and permanent public URL. Safe to call again — a finished upload returns the same result. A file that fails the checks is discarded. Output: { mediaId, status: 'ready', url, kind, contentType, sizeBytes, filename }.
name: finalize_media_upload

contentType.description: Content type detected from the stored bytes

mediaId.description: Opaque id (med_…) — pass it to create_post_from_video

url.description: Permanent public URL of the stored file

title: Finalize Media Upload
